Cyngn reports over 11,600 autonomous missions in nine months

The company reports more than 3,000 kilometres across customer operations.

Cyngn ↗9 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

A new reporting period

Cyngn reports more than 11,600 missions and 3,000 kilometres during the first nine months of 2026. September marked its highest monthly activity.

Starting with one route

DriveMod Tuggers move materials between workstations on defined routes. EasyLaunch starts with one vehicle and route for a monthly payment; Cyngn Insight manages fleets.

Limits of the figures

These company-reported figures lack fleet size and detailed customer breakdowns. They therefore cannot establish per-vehicle productivity or a return on investment for every facility.
